note: Switches the app and the website read without a new release (Hidde, 2026-11-05: "kunnen we deze vragenlijst uit de app halen zonder een release"). The website reads this at build time (site/src/lib/switches.ts); the app reads it from /api/version.json on every launch and every return to the app (Kit/AppSwitches.swift).
